text:
Fiona: Tiny mystery: there9s a rubber duck taped to the printer with a note that says 'I supervised your print job.' Who is our covert supervisor? :duck:
Ethan: Not me. I only supervise snack theft. :sweat_smile:
Lena: Quick poll: react :one: for 'Team Ops', :two: for 'QA', :three: for 'Maya (guilty until proven innocent)'.
Raj: One-liner challenge while we vote: best duck-related pun wins the honor of releasing the duck back into the wild. Drop puns. :trophy:
Maya: "Quackademic review: all prints pass." I9ll see myself out.
Fiona: "Rubber duck debugging got competitive." Someone is doing actual R&D on our printers.
Ethan: "When in doubt, quack it out." Solid advice.
Lena: emoji-bot: Reminder: please don't affix non-essential objects to shared devices. Small things can cause jams.
emoji-bot: :information_source: Tip added to #office-notes: "Supervisory duck policy: decorative only, not for paper trays."
Raj: Vote tally so far: 2s leading. Also, if Team Ops did it, they get a sticker. If Maya did it, she gets two stickers.
Maya: I plead the quack. But I will accept sticker consequences either way.
Ethan: Final vote: QA wins by one. Duck will be living on the whiteboard until Friday.
Fiona: Thanks folks. Whoever claims the duck, please sign the tiny guestbook I taped under it. Community stewardship matters. :spiral_notepad:
Lena: Also shoutout to Raj for fixing the stapler earlier. Office hero. :raised_hands:
Raj: Thanks! I accept celebratory one-liners as tribute.
Maya: "Stapling: the silent binder of teamwork." Mic drop.
Ethan: Meeting adjourned. Duck escorted to safety. :duck::camera_with_flash:
